draft_key_information_units.information: Net profit for 2025 was €28.7 million, an 11% decrease from 2024.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Managing Director’s Statement: 'Coop Pank’s net profit amounted to €28.7 million in 2025, decreasing by 11% year-on-year.' Financial results table confirms net profit 28.7 (2025) vs 32.2 (2024).

draft_key_information_units.information: Loan portfolio grew 19% to €2.11 billion by end of 2025, exceeding €2 billion for the first time.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Managing Director’s Statement: 'The bank’s loan portfolio grew by €340 million (+19%) in 2025. For the first time in Coop Pank’s history, our loan portfolio exceeded €2 billion.' Financial results table: Net loan portfolio 2,114 (2025) vs 1,774 (2024).

draft_key_information_units.information: Number of customers reached 227,000 by end of 2025, up 19,000 (+9%) during the year.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Managing Director’s Statement and 'Increase in the number of customers' section: 'The number of Coop Pank customers grew by 19,000 (+9%) in 2025, reaching 227,000 by the end of the year.'

draft_key_information_units.information: Customer deposits increased 9% to €2.05 billion by end of 2025.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial results table and 'Increase in deposits' section: 'Coop Pank’s deposits increased by 9% over the year, reaching 2.05 billion euros by the end of 2025.' Consolidated Statement of Financial Position: Customer deposits 2,047,459 (2025).

draft_key_information_units.information: First issuance of €250 million covered bonds (four-year maturity) on Irish stock exchange as part of €750 million program, providing long-term stable funding.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Managing Director’s Statement: 'In the first quarter of 2025, Coop Pank issued covered bonds on the Irish stock exchange for the first time, amounting to €250 million with a four-year maturity. This was the first tranche of a €750 million covered bond program.'

draft_key_information_units.information: Entered guarantee agreement with European Investment Bank Group for synthetic securitization, transferring credit risk on part of loan portfolio to enable up to €249 million in new loans to businesses, with focus on gender equality and environmental sustainability.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Managing Director’s Statement: 'At the end of the year, Coop Pank entered into a guarantee agreement with the European Investment Bank Group... enabling the bank to issue up to €249 million in new loans to businesses... This is Coop Pank’s first synthetic securitization transaction.'

draft_key_information_units.information: Strategic targets include increasing loan market share to at least 10% by end of 2030, doubling net profit to at least €60 million by 2030, maintaining cost-to-income ratio ≤45%, and ROE ≥15%.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Targets section and Managing Director’s Statement: 'Over the next five years (by the end of 2030), our strategic goal is to increase the Bank’s loan market share in Estonia at least to 10%... The Bank’s objective is to double its profit over the next five years and reach a net profit of at least 60 million euros by 2030... cost to income ratio not exceeding 45%... ROE of at least 15%.'

draft_key_information_units.information: Return on equity decreased to 12.9% in 2025 from 16.2% in 2024; cost-to-income ratio increased to 52.3% from 49.6%.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial results table: 'Return on equity (ROE) % 12.9 (2025) vs 16.2 (2024)'; 'Cost to income ratio, % 52.3 (2025) vs 49.6 (2024)'.

evaluation.selection_rationale: Selected 8 units focusing on headline performance (profit, loans, deposits, customers), major financing/capital events (covered bonds, EIB securitization), strategic outlook, and key ratios. These represent independently omittable material themes directly supported by the SOURCE report's management statement, financial tables, and strategy sections. Units align with priorities for financial performance, period changes, and developments while avoiding boilerplate. REFERENCE support noted only where content overlaps with the provided summary.
